decisions.subject: China book
decisions.lean: HK NAV ~HK$990k, benchmark FXI. Regime read: Q3 stagflation, PBoC liquidity still contracting, and HK is the fragile venue — it dances to the dollar and the peg, so a strong USD bleeds southbound money out. Fear-Euphoria prints "Greed" (75) but the confirmation panel disagrees: 5 of 8 legs are risk-off (southbound outflows, thin margin, weak CNH, QVIX). Posture is ROTATE_DEFENSIVE (shadow). So I keep a deliberate ~36% cash buffer and run a quality/ballast core rather than chasing the deep-cyclical laggards (solar/EV/metals) where flows are piling — that's contrarian bottom-fishing into contracting liquidity, wrong risk for a fragile tape. Net exposure is held near prior (~64% vs ~66%); this is a composition upgrade, not a directional bet: consolidate the three-plus-bank sprawl by dropping the smallest (Bank of China 3988.HK), let the one confirmed momentum winner (CSPC 1093.HK, innovative-drugs — the market's strongest breadth theme) run, and add one small corroborated starter (Smoore 6969.HK). Ballast is Tencent (0700.HK) quality tech oversold, China Mobile (0941.HK) + China Telecom (0728.HK) high-yield telecoms, CCB (0939.HK) + ICBC (1398.HK) high-yield banks, Power Assets (0006.HK) defensive utility, Ping An (2318.HK), and Alibaba (9988.HK).
decisions.thesis: Sold Bank of China (3988.HK, was 3.2%) to consolidate an over-diversified four-name big-bank sleeve down to the two strongest reads (CCB 0939.HK UPTREND + ICBC 1398.HK). Redeployed a small slice into a Smoore (6969.HK) starter and kept the rest in the cash buffer. Net invested held near prior (~64% vs ~66%) — a composition upgrade, not a change in net HK exposure, consistent with the fragile-tape / rotate-defensive posture.
